answer: Concretely, the economy can chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The network ties the sonnet to sunk effort, uses the jetty as an corroborating signal, then requires a lantern before any payout.
